verses.1: The words of Jehovah are spoken in the land of Chadrach. His “demon” is set free, for Jehovah has eyes like those of a human being, and all the rulers of Israel belong to Him.
verses.2: And also, its strength will be limited there. Its sides and edges will be weak, because it is very wise.
verses.3: And she built a palace for her, with gold and silver as decorations.
verses.4: Now, Adonai will take her by force; He will throw her into the sea. And she will be consumed by fire.
verses.5: Ashkelon will be seen and feared; it will become a place of terror. Ashkelon will begin to decline rapidly, and its people will perish. The king of Ashkelon will die, and Ashkelon will no longer exist.
verses.6: And he sat in Ashdod, and I recognized the pride of Philistines.
verses.7: And I took out his blood from his mouth, and removed the dirt from between his teeth. He remained with our God. He became like a cherubim in Judah.
verses.8: And I have set up my house in a place where it cannot be passed over or crossed. Now, I can see with my own eyes.
verses.9: Gili Meod, daughter of Zion Hariyim, daughter of Jerusalem. Now, your king will come to you. He is a righteous and just man. He is poor, and he rides on a donkey and a colt.
verses.10: And I have known the horses from Ephraim, and the chariots from Jerusalem. War has been abolished, and there is peace among the nations. From one sea to another, and from one river to the ends of the earth.
verses.11: Also, in your blood of covenant, I have sent your prisoners from the prison where there is no water.
verses.12: Return to your prison, prisoners of the covenant. Even today, I will say differently: I will speak to you again.
verses.13: For I have walked in the ways of Judah; I have filled my nostrils with evil. I have troubled your children, Zion; and you have been treated like a thorn in my flesh.
verses.14: And Jehovah will appear upon them, and a lightning bolt will be sent out from him. Then Jehovah’s throne will be set up in the midst of the stormy winds.
verses.15: Yehova, your army, will protect them. They will eat and drink, just like fish do. They will be filled up like balloons, just like bubbles.
verses.16: And Jehovah their God will save them on that day, like sheep being led to the pen. For the stones of Enrogil will be scattered over their land.
verses.17: For what good is it to have a seed in the wilderness, when its fruit will be destroyed by drought?
